text:
ian: I'm trying to port the redwood-inference-sdk example to Cloudflare Workers and the build output complains about 'require' and 'Buffer'. bundle target is 'browser' in vite. Anyone solved this?

noj: Workers are strict ESM. Vite target 'webworker' + build.lib.format 'es' helps. Also ensure you don't bundle types/node.

taylor: we ran into the Buffer problem — the SDK was importing 'buffer' via a transitive dep. quick fix: in esbuild config add --define:globalThis.process=undefined and alias buffer->false or add shim 'import { Buffer } from "buffer"' and polyfill with 'npm i buffer' then add "inject": ["./polyfills/buffer.js"]. but long term we removed Buffer usage in edge code path.

ian: can you paste that esbuild snippet?

taylor: sure:
```js
// build.edge.js
require('esbuild').build({
  entryPoints: ['src/worker.ts'],
  bundle: true,
  target: ['chrome89','safari13'],
  platform: 'browser',
  format: 'esm',
  define: { 'process.env.NODE_ENV': '"production"' },
  inject: ['./polyfills/globalThis.js']
})
```
polyfills/globalThis.js:
```js
import { Buffer } from 'buffer';
if (!globalThis.Buffer) globalThis.Buffer = Buffer;
```

marie: FYI for TS folks: tsserver will still error on imports from 'redwood-inference-sdk/dist/node' if your tsconfig has "types": ["node"]. For worker projects we set "types": [], add "lib": ["es2021", "webworker"] and "skipLibCheck": true to avoid node types leaking in.

ian: I also hit 'module has no exports' from upstream package with package.exports map. Turns out our bundler picked the conditional requiring node's cjs. The fix was to add "browser": {"./lib/node.js":"./lib/edge.js"} in package.json of the sample wrapper. Ugly but worked.

noj: instead of editing package.json, consider an entry file that re-exports the ESM/edge build of the SDK and force imports from that path — keeps node and edge builds separate.

marie: CI note — add a job that runs 'wrangler publish --dry-run' and 'miniflare' smoke test. We added a lint rule 'no-node-globals-in-edge' to catch accidental Buffer/process usage in edge directories.

dev-bot: linked: https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/tooling/ and https://esbuild.github.io/ and https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/512 (edge builds).

ian: thanks all, going to try the inject polyfill first then switch to explicit edge-only entry if it fails. will post results. :rocket:
